list.name: LoadId
list.query: select distinct LoadId from TestLoad order by LoadId desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia para interpretar cumplimiento de licencias y riesgos asociados.

options.content: Que muestra: estado de licencias por host, servicio, dominio y tecnologia. Como interpretarlo: NonCompliant, Unknown o Unverified requieren evidencia o remediacion; no son estado OK. Accion sugerida: priorizar hosts criticos y servicios afectados antes de auditorias o renovaciones.

panels.title: Resumen de Licencias
panels.description: Conteo de hosts por estado de licencia y cumplimiento para identificar brechas de auditoria.

targets.rawSql: select LicenseStatus, ComplianceStatus, count(*) as HostCount from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' group by LicenseStatus, ComplianceStatus order by case LicenseStatus when 'NonCompliant' then 1 when 'Unverified' then 2 when 'Unknown' then 3 else 4 end, ComplianceStatus

panels.title: Hosts con Riesgo de Licencia
panels.description: Detalle operativo para decidir remediacion, compra, normalizacion o validacion de evidencia de licencia.

targets.rawSql: select ComponentName as HostName, TechnologyType, DomainName, BusinessServiceId, Owner, LicenseStatus, ComplianceStatus, EvidenceState from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and LicenseStatus in ('NonCompliant','Unverified','Unknown') order by case LicenseStatus when 'NonCompliant' then 1 when 'Unverified' then 2 else 3 end, ComponentName

panels.title: Riesgos y Acciones de Licencia
panels.description: Riesgos de compliance asociados a licenciamiento con impacto y accion recomendada.

targets.rawSql: select r.Severity, c.ComponentName as HostName, c.LicenseStatus, c.ComplianceStatus, r.Impact, r.RecommendedAction, r.EvidenceState from EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = r.AffectedTechnologyId where r.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and r.RiskCategory = 'Compliance' order by case r.Severity when 'Critical' then 1 when 'High' then 2 when 'Medium' then 3 else 4 end, c.ComponentName
